purpose: Reproduce deterministic multi-suite pipeline, adversarial evidence and capacity checks. No models, hosted execution or deployment.

created.limits: Actual stdlib test invocations and Git commits; dependency outage and promotion are synthetic/local. Controller applies known fixture corrections, not a live agent evaluation.

junit_adapter.limits: UTF-8 unnamespaced JUnit subset. Suite/class/name identity; retries need separate attempt reports. No provider completeness proof.

full_failure_export.mode: Streaming stdout verification; full rows remain reconstructible from preserved SQLite, no top-N truncation.

regression_observation.pre_fix_million_row_attempt: Stopped after prolonged query; raw input and partial database retained; not a completed measurement.
regression_observation.mechanism: SQLite 3.53.1 EXPLAIN materialized the baseline view and scanned it for each candidate failure. An indexed current-result snapshot removes that scan; full history remains separate.

reproduction.setup: Use exact implementation revision in an isolated checkout and Python 3.11+. Create new lab/output destinations under an existing physical parent; do not overwrite evidence. All fixture/controller source is independently authored.
reproduction.faults: Preserve original inputs. Missing-shard/partial-inventory/recovered-retry are controlled mutations of copied plan/report metadata beside original report files, analyzed in fresh output directories. Wrong-artifact hashes different local bytes; stale-stage uses a past completion beyond policy. Expected blocked exits are separately captured; malformed schema/input exits 2. Full fixtures are in tests/test_ci_evidence.py.
reproduction.scale: pipeline_lab.py stress --root <new-scale> --records-per-cohort N --failure-every K; N=50000 or 500000, K=0,10 or1 as named. analyze in a fresh directory. Records are generated, not executed tests. No model call.
reproduction.measurement: For each final scale point use a fresh Python process. After importing ci_evidence, time analyze with time.perf_counter. Peak resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss is bytes on the observed Darwin host; convert KiB on Linux. Measure SQLite file bytes and SELECT count(*) FROM results. Excludes input generation/module import time and full export time; RSS includes process imports. Each point is one local observation, not a statistical benchmark.
reproduction.export: Stream ci_evidence.py failures output without collecting rows in memory. Verify all 500000 rows have status=failed and comparison=new_failure, count lines and hash raw stdout; preserve the SQLite source for reconstruction. No top-N filtering.
reproduction.junit: Generate a testsuite with 100000 uniquely named testcases, every 100th with an AssertionError failure and message bad 42. Include matching tests/failures/errors/skipped counters. Convert with junit_evidence.py and verify 99000 passes/1000 failures plus source/normalized hashes. These are generated report records, not executed testcases.
reproduction.calibration: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; includes 1000-slot completeness, report/candidate integrity, retry history, coverage, release faults, JUnit rejection and managed skills-only packaging. No credentials/models.
reproduction.retention: Complete raw reports, fixtures/Git state, partial and successful databases, commands, logs and receipts remain ignored local output/bulk-ci-20261025. Public summary/protocol are not downloadable raw evidence.
reproduction.source_recovery: This repository squash-merges and deletes feature branches. In an isolated clone, git fetch origin refs/pull/16/head retains the reviewed head ancestry, including implementation_revision. Use git show/archive of the pinned full revision; do not reset an active checkout.

limits: Offline synthetic exercise and generated capacity data; no live-agent routing/outcome qualification.
Dependency availability and promotion are simulated; real unittest calls/source commits and report processing are exercised.
No hosted provider authentication, pagination API, VM fleet, production deployment, concurrent-writer or arbitrary maximum-input qualification.
Single host and single observation per final scale point; no portable throughput guarantee.
Orbyn synchronization and REA engine/source upgrade deferred.
